en.headline: Inbound rush expected at land borders this Sunday afternoon
en.dek: The Transport Department said waiting times for public transport will lengthen as mainland Mid-Autumn holiday travellers return, with extra East Rail and shuttle services running.
body: The Transport Department has warned of a marked inbound peak at land-based boundary control points this Sunday afternoon and evening, as travellers return at the end of the mainland Mid-Autumn Festival holiday from 25 to 27 September.

The department said waiting times for public transport will be longer. The MTR Corporation is enhancing East Rail Line trains between Admiralty and Lo Wu and Lok Ma Chau according to demand. Extra short-haul High Speed Rail trips are running between Hong Kong West Kowloon and Futian and Shenzhenbei stations through Sunday, and sleeper services to Beijing West have also been strengthened.

During peak hours the Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge Gold Bus is scheduled about every minute and the Lok Ma Chau–Huanggang Yellow Bus about every two minutes. Franchised B-route buses to the land crossings are running above normal weekend frequencies, and the quota of cross-boundary coaches has been increased.

The department advised travellers to set off early, avoid the busiest hours if they can, keep order in queues and follow instructions from police and station staff. Motorists were told to expect longer waits at vehicle plazas and to stay out of the emergency lane on the Bridge unless directed by Zhuhai authorities.

zh.headline: 內地中秋假期尾聲 當局料周日下午口岸入境高峰
zh.dek: 運輸署預計今日下午至晚上陸路口岸入境人流上升，過境公共交通輪候時間會較長，東鐵及金巴黃巴已加密班次。
body: 運輸署呼籲，內地中秋假期（9月25日至27日）踏入最後一日，今日下午至晚上陸路口岸預計出現明顯入境高峰，過境公共交通輪候時間會較長。
港鐵按客量加密金鐘至羅湖及落馬洲的東鐵細班次。高鐵香港段往返福田及深圳北的短途班次已加開至周日，往北京西的夕發朝至臥舖亦有加密。繁忙時間港珠澳大橋金巴平均約每分鐘一班，落馬洲至皇崗黃巴約每兩分鐘一班；接駁陸路口岸的專利巴士B絮班次高於一般周末，過境巴士配額亦已增加。
運輸署呼籲旅客提早出發、盡量避開繁忙時段，排隊時保持秩序並聽從現場警員及運輸機構職員指示。自駕過境人士須預留更多時間，並注意珠海當局在大橋主橋的交通管制，未經指示不得佔用緊急車道。
